$comment: Decentralized House contract — stakers (including ape.church's Deployer and Treasury wallets) stake APE to act as the house and earn yield. Blizzard Blitz routes losing-spin APE here; players stake/unstake and claim yield. 'stake_in' / 'unstake_out' are used for flows where counterparty == tx.from (typical staker interaction).
